question: First ever Khelo India Zanskar Winter Sports festival was inaugurated in January 2021 at______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kargil**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first ever **Khelo India Zanskar Winter Sports festival** was inaugurated in **January 2021** at **Kargil**.
 
• This festival is part of the **Khelo India initiative**, which aims to promote sports culture in India at the grassroots level.
 
• The event features a variety of winter sports such as ice climbing, ice hockey, and snow skiing, among others.
 
• The festival aims to attract tourists and highlight the potential of winter sports in the region.
 
• The initiative also seeks to **engage the youth of the region in sports activities**, promoting a healthy lifestyle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kargil** is a district in the Union Territory of **Ladakh**, known for its strategic significance and natural beauty.
 
• The **Khelo India** initiative was launched by the Government of India to revive the sports culture in India at the grassroots level by building a strong framework for all sports played in our country and establishing India as a great sporting nation.
 
• The **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** is responsible for the implementation of the Khelo India program.
 
• The Khelo India Zanskar Winter Sports festival is expected to become an annual event, contributing to the region's tourism and economy.
